calculation.expression: signal = -(sum_{i=0..2} return_{t-i}) after (lagged VIX daily-return > rolling-60d 75th percentile) AND (lagged cross-sectional std(return_t) > rolling-60d 75th percentile); demean cross-section
calculation.description: On the first date after a jointly elevated VIX shock and cross-asset return dispersion, rank assets by negative trailing three-day return, with cross-sectional median demeaning. Observation-only VIX is used for conditioning; no order is submitted for VIX. The signal is lagged and evaluated against forward five-trading-day returns.

validation.regime_notes: Conditional factor is sparse: 638 dates met the conditioning event and 88 dates had usable 5-day cross-sectional IC. Regime IC was negative in 2020-2022 (-0.09517) and positive in 2023-2024 (+0.08935), 2025-2026 (+0.11105), and 2027-to-cutoff (+0.20727; one observation). Interpret uncertainty conservatively because the 15-asset universe and 88-date IC sample are small.
